title: Pipeline Report
description: Access logs contain repeated HTTP status codes that need to be summarized.
mission: Count the 500 responses and write the number into answer.txt.
success: You produced the correct error count.
solution: awk '$9 == 500 { count++ } END { print count }' access.log

lesson.what_happened: A pipeline reduced a large log to the records and aggregate you needed.
lesson.be_careful: Match the status-code field, not an arbitrary 500 appearing elsewhere.

hints: grep can feed its output to another command with |.
